scripts.commands: cd .. && uv run python -c "import json; from dofile._vendor.opendta.session import Session; from dofile._vendor.opendta.commands.registry import REGISTRY as R; print(json.dumps({'commands': {k: v.min_abbrev for k, v in sorted(R.items())}, 'prefixes': sorted(k for k, v in R.items() if v.prefix)}, indent=0))" > web/src/stata/commands.json
scripts.sample: cd .. && uv run python web/sample/make_sample.py && cd web && node scripts/make-sample.ts
scripts.dev: npm run wheel && (node scripts/build-id.ts --warn || true) && node scripts/together.ts dev
scripts.build: npm run wheel && vite build && vite build --mode site
scripts.e2e: npm run snapshot && npm run build:local && playwright test
scripts.cf:dev: npm run snapshot && DOFILE_SITE_URL=${DOFILE_SITE_URL:-http://localhost:8787/} DOFILE_EDITOR_URL=${DOFILE_EDITOR_URL:-http://localhost:8788/} npm run build && (wrangler dev --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8787 & wrangler dev --config wrangler.app.jsonc --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/state-app & wait)
scripts.deploy: npm run lint:strict && npm run snapshot && DOFILE_URLS=production npm run build && node scripts/check-sizes.ts && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.app.jsonc && wrangler deploy
